invariants.rationale: The method always returns a Pair object combining partitionPathStatMap and globalStat.
partitionPathStatMap is always instantiated before returning as part of result.

meta.value: The map holding statistics per partition is initialized and returned.

invariants.rationale: globalStat is always instantiated and returned as the right element of the Pair.

meta.value: The global workload stat object is initialized and returned.

invariants.rationale: partitionPathStatMap is populated based on inputRecords partitions. If inputRecords is null, no grouping.

meta.value: All partition paths in inputRecords should be represented or inputRecords is null.

invariants.rationale: WorkloadStat accumulates counts of updates and inserts, which are never negative.

meta.value: Global workload stat counts cannot be negative.
